messages.content: How long had Zeb waited at the station before Dorothy arrived?
Five hours.
How did he say Californians felt about earthquakes?
They were used to them and were not very scared.
What did Eureka first ask Dorothy for after the buggy landed on a roof?
Her milk.
Why did she ask for it?
She was very hungry.
What did the messenger announce after the Sorcerer predicted no more rains?
More wonders in the air.
Where did the Prince and his people go to see them?
Into the street.
Who inspected the Wizard's hat before he did his trick for the Mangaboos?
The Sorcerer.
Why did the Prince plan to keep the Wizard after Gwig was cut in two?
He was skillful and useful.
What did the Wizard plan to nap on in the House of the Sorcerer?
A hard glass bench.
Where did Dorothy choose to sleep?
In a little room at the end of the hall.
What were the Mangaboos stacking in front of the Black Pit when the Wizard arrived?
Glass rocks.
How did Dorothy say Jim could defend himself when the man in Voe asked?
He could kick and bite.
What did the Woggle-Bug pull from his pocket before turning his back on the company?
A book.
Why did Dorothy say she could not stay away from Kansas for long?
Uncle Henry and Aunt Em needed her.
